KamusEntryDoc.title: KamusEntryDoc
KamusEntryDoc.description: A user's saved Arabic vocabulary word, phrase, or idiom with spaced-repetition (SRS) state and contextual metadata, synced across Android and Web.

arabic.description: Vocalized Arabic word, phrase, or idiom (1 to 500 characters).

meaning.description: Indonesian meaning or explanation (optional, max 2000 characters).

turatsOrigin.description: Classical Arabic / turats root or origin note (optional, max 1000 characters).

synonymNote.description: Synonym or semantic nuance note (optional, max 1500 characters).

kind.description: Entry classification: word, phrase, or idiom.

lessonId.description: Source lesson or course block identifier (optional, max 200 characters).

lessonTitle.description: Human-readable source lesson title (optional, max 300 characters).

segmentLabel.description: Video timestamp segment label (optional, max 200 characters).

segmentStartSec.description: Video start timestamp in seconds (optional, 0 to 86400).

contextSentence.description: Original Arabic context sentence (optional, max 2000 characters).

personalNote.description: User's personal study note (optional, max 2000 characters).

nextReviewEpochDay.description: Epoch day scheduled for next SRS review (>= 0).

createdAtMillis.description: Original creation timestamp in epoch milliseconds (>= 0), immutable after creation.

reviewCount.description: Total number of SRS review attempts (>= 0).

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp(); immutable after creation.

updatedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every create and update.

LearningProgressDoc.title: LearningProgressDoc
LearningProgressDoc.description: User's synced learning completion and favorite module state across Android and Web.

completedArabicIds.description: List of completed Arabic lesson IDs (max 500 items).

favoriteArabicIds.description: List of favorited Arabic lesson IDs (max 500 items).

completedCourseBlockIds.description: List of completed series course topic block IDs (max 500 items).

lastOpenedLessonId.description: Most recently opened Arabic lesson ID (optional, max 200 characters).

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp(); immutable after creation.

updatedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every create and update.

/users/{userId}/kamus/{entryId}.description: Per-user private Kamus Saya vocabulary entries synced in real time between Android and Web.

/users/{userId}/progress/{progressId}.description: Per-user private learning completion and favorite lesson progress document (e.g. progressId = 'learning_v1').
